values.description: Set APP_SECURITY_COOKIE_SECURE=false on the backend if testing over plain HTTP locally (no TLS) -- otherwise the Secure-flagged ACCESS_TOKEN cookie is silently dropped by the client and login will look like it does nothing. See backend README.
Must match an ADMIN account you inserted directly into Postgres -- see collection description.
Plaintext password matching the BCrypt hash you inserted for adminEmail.
Used as the newPassword field value for Activate Account / Complete Password Reset requests.
